scripts.build: vite build && BUILD_TARGET=content vite build && BUILD_TARGET=background vite build && BUILD_TARGET=editor vite build && BUILD_TARGET=offscreen vite build && rm -rf dist/.DS_Store
scripts.zip: npm run build && cd dist && zip -r ../proscreen-s3-v$npm_package_version.zip . && cd .. && echo 'Created proscreen-s3-v'$npm_package_version'.zip'
scripts.zip:firefox: npm run build:firefox && cd dist-firefox && zip -r ../proscreen-s3-firefox-v$npm_package_version.zip . && cd .. && echo 'Created Firefox zip'
